name: Barachiah
overview: The name Barachiah, also rendered Berechiah or Barachias, identifies the father of the prophet Zechariah, as seen in Zechariah 1:1 and 1:7 where Zechariah is introduced as the son of Berechiah, son of Iddo. Matthew 23:35 references Barachias as the father of Zechariah, whose righteous blood was shed between the temple and the altar, underscoring the prophetic legacy and the martyrdom connected with this lineage. These passages collectively highlight Barachiah's role as the patriarch in the prophetic line central to God's revelation during the post-exilic period.
